title: Zoospore Isolation of Aurantiochytrium limacinum
author: Mariana Rius
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u73ezqn

steps.title: Prepare Initial Inoculum
steps.instruction: Inoculate 500 ul GPY media in a microcentrifuge tube with a toothpick scrape of a colony.

substeps.instruction: If inoculating a zeocin resistant colony, add 5 ul zeocin (for 100 ug/ml)

steps.title: Culture for Zoospore Production
steps.instruction: Prepare a culture tube and incubate until zoospores are present.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 4.5 ml of GPY into a 15 ml glass culture tube
Incubate at 28 C, 170 rpm for 48 h, or until microscopy reveals the presence of zoospores

steps.title: Filter and Concentrate Culture
steps.instruction: Filter the culture and collect the flowthrough.

substeps.instruction: Filter culture using a 5 um nylon filter membrane, nalgene filter holder, and filtration pump
Transfer flowthrough to a microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: Resuspend and Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and plate a dilution for colony growth.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in 100 ul of ½ Artificial Seawater (ASW) or media
Make a 10X dilution by adding 10 ul of cells to 90 ul of ½ ASW or media
Spread onto 2% agar GPY (+ zeocin +amp) plate
Incubate at 28 C for 48 - 72 h until colonies appear
